messages.subject: Sporadic bad mixing?
parts:
Hi,

I'm testing several hierarchical models and sometimes I have this mixing problem and wonder if anyone has some hints about its origin.

Sometimes, my hierarchical model runs without mixing problems. But sometimes, the same model runs into a period of poor mixing as illustrated in the attached figure. Poor mixing often starts at the onset of "Sampling" (at the end of "Adapting")... I use reparameterization (e.g., Chapter 16. Optimizing Stan Code, page 98). Any suggestions would be appreciated!
